name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd
basis: Standalone (ONGC's own domestic E&P business). The street prices ONGC on standalone earnings plus its stakes; consolidated accounts are dominated by HPCL (54.9%) and MRPL (71.6%) refining and marketing, with large minorities.

ppacSep.what: Domestic gas price for Sep-2026: US$9.00/mmBtu; ceiling for ONGC/OIL nomination gas US$7.00/mmBtu

eia.what: EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook, Sep-2026: Brent ~US$90/bbl in 2H2026, US$74 average in 2027 (US$77 in Q2-2027, ~US$67 in 2H2027)

shares._why: Equity capital ₹6,290.1 cr at ₹5 face value (AR FY26); EPS FY26 ₹26.15 on PAT ₹32,894 cr

business.summary: India's largest oil and gas producer: 73% of India's crude and 57% of its natural gas in FY26 (AR FY26 MD&A). Standalone = domestic nomination fields (awarded before 1999, on government-set terms) plus ONGC's share of PSC/JV blocks. Overseas E&P sits in ONGC Videsh (100%); refining and marketing in HPCL (54.9%) and MRPL (71.6%); petrochemicals in OPaL; renewables in ONGC Green.

fy26._note: AR FY26 p.21 ten-year table (Rs million converted to Rs crore)

production._note: AR FY26 MD&A p.256; crude includes condensate

macro._note: PPAC data in AR FY26 MD&A p.255 (chart labels; year order read from the chart)

q1fy27._note: Standalone. Brent averaged ~US$97-98/bbl in the quarter (management on the call); realisation = Brent + ~1% contract premium

guidance.production: Standalone oil + gas (excluding JVs) ~39 MMTOE in FY27 (38.87 in FY26) and ~40 MMTOE in FY28, the FY28 gain split ~50:50 oil and gas; FY27 oil about flat, gas +~1 BCM (call, 5-Aug-2026)
guidance.gasProjects: Daman Upside (DUDP) +2 mmscmd by Dec-2026 (to ~3); East Coast CPP ~1.3 mmscmd; Tapti/Daman wells ~0.5 mmscmd; KG-DWN-98/2 gas 1.5-1.7 mmscmd now, ~3 mmscmd by Q4FY27 and 6-7 mmscmd by Q4FY28
guidance.kg982Oil: ~21,000 bbl/d; reservoir connectivity problems under study; each re-entry costs >₹500 cr
guidance.capex: US$3.5-4.0 bn a year (₹33,000-38,000 cr at ₹95/US$), FY27 and FY28; upside in exploration capex from Samudra Manthan
guidance.westernOffshore: Projects worth >₹40,000 cr under execution; Mumbai High TSP (BP) at 107% of oil and 113% of gas baseline
guidance.ovl: Sakhalin-1 back in OVL's accounts from Jan-2026; OVL earning ~₹1,000 cr a quarter; Mozambique LNG first gas end-FY28/early FY29 (~3 MMTPA share); Venezuela OFAC licence obtained
guidance.longRunOil: Management expects US$75+/bbl in the long run after the Hormuz crisis

stakes._note: Shares held directly by ONGC on 31-Mar-2026 (AR FY26 standalone note 11.1); unchanged to 30-Sep-2026 in our sources

otherIncomeFy26._tax: Dividends received are deductible under section 80M to the extent ONGC distributes dividends (AR note 39.1)

levies._note: Other levies incl. SAED (windfall tax, Jul-2022 to Dec-2024)

fiveYear._note: FY25 capex includes right-of-use additions; FY23 restated exceptional item ₹9,235 cr (as reported ₹8,000-odd cr in Screener EPS 30.86)

policy.apm: Kirit Parikh formula since Apr-2023: APM gas = 10% of the Indian crude basket, floor US$4, ceiling US$6.50 rising US$0.25 a year from FY26: US$6.75 (FY26), US$7.00 (FY27). New-well gas from nomination fields gets a 20% premium. HPHT/deepwater ceiling US$8.9 for Apr-Sep 2026 (AR FY26 MD&A).
policy.apmNotified: Sep-2026: formula price US$9.00, ONGC/OIL ceiling US$7.00 (PPAC, 31-Aug-2026)
policy.royalty: Royalty cut notified 8-May-2026 under the Oilfields (Regulation and Development) Act: onshore crude 16.66%->10%, offshore crude 9.09%->8%, gas 10%->8%; a 4-Jun-2026 gazette restored 16.66% on pre-NELP onland crude; offshore and gas cuts stand. CLSA: +US$2.4-3/bbl to ONGC's net crude realisation at US$80-100 (https://www.angelone.in/news/economy/government-restores-crude-oil-royalty-rate-on-pre-nelp-onland-blocks-to-16-66, Jun-2026; https://psuwatch.com/newsupdates/india-cuts-oil-gas-royalty-rates-in-landmark-upstream-reform-icra-says-move-will-improve-project-returns, May-2026)
policy.windfall: SAED on domestic crude imposed Jul-2022, abolished Dec-2024 (₹11,054 cr in FY23, ₹8,720 cr FY24, ₹4,032 cr FY25); not re-imposed by 30-Sep-2026 despite Brent near US$100 in Q1FY27; JM says the share price discounts ~US$60/bbl of net realisation because of the fear
policy.samudraManthan: National Offshore Exploration Scheme approved with ₹84,084 cr outlay (government funds part of deepwater well costs; each well ₹800-1,000 cr)

governance.cmd: Arun Kumar Singh, Chairman & CEO (formerly CMD of BPCL), re-employed on contract for a further year from 7-Dec-2025 or until a regular incumbent takes charge, whichever is earlier
governance.board: Government nominee directors; the AGM notice records the absence of a Nomination and Remuneration Committee for the reappointment
governance.contingent: Panna-Mukta-Tapti JV arbitration against the government: contingent liability ~₹15,216 cr; ONGC did not join the arbitration at the ministry's informal request (call)
